payload.name: Hot-Path Payload Deepcopy Overhead and Provider Detection Drift
payload.description: Running copy.deepcopy(payload) and double json.dumps serialization on every request in src/holon_coherence/payload_cleaner.py (JSONContextCleaner.process_payload_with_stats) adds quadratic CPU and memory overhead on large multi-turn LLM transcripts, while duplicating provider detection heuristics across src/holon_coherence/proxy/addon.py (MITMProxyInterceptor.detect_provider) and src/holon_coherence/providers/__init__.py (detect_provider_name) causes silent routing and cleaning drift (such as mismatched Claude model detection and 'system' vs 'messages' precedence).
payload.action: Avoid full recursive copy.deepcopy on request hot paths by using targeted copy-on-write shallow copies for mutated message lists/blocks, route all provider detection, cleaning, cache-key extraction, and token parsing through the single ProviderFormat registry in src/holon_coherence/providers/ (base.py, __init__.py, anthropic.py, openai.py, gemini.py), and enforce parity in tests/providers/test_registry.py and tests/proxy/test_addon_pipeline_parity.py.
symptoms: Proxy request latency and RSS memory grow sharply with conversation length due to full copy.deepcopy() and repeated json.dumps() per turn.

Provider detection in MITMProxyInterceptor.detect_provider disagrees with providers.detect_provider_name on ambiguous payloads (e.g., payloads with both 'system' and 'messages' or Claude model names on custom endpoints).
Adding a new provider endpoint or payload heuristic requires editing multiple files and leaves stale behavior in one code path.
